title: On the Thin Side
text: On the Thin Side. My nice, thick anti-fatigue mats were in desperate need of being replaced. They had gotten dinged up pretty badly over the last few years. Plus they were boring black. I saw these and thought that the grey color would look nice in my kitchen. They only look grey in natural light. When my LED kitchen lights are on, they look lavender in color. My kitchen is a green color and the lavender looking mats look awful! Plus, they are on the thin side and don't offer as much comfort and support as my old black ones. And for some reason, my cat has decided to use these as a scratching mat! She never did that with the old ones either. I am on the lookout for some new, thicker ones now.
